topics.title_zh: Anthropic与NYU修复纳维-斯托克斯方程AI证明漏洞
topics.title_en: Anthropic and NYU Patch Navier-Stokes AI-Aided Proof
topics.summary_zh: 针对OpenAI此前被指存在逻辑缺漏的流体力学证明，Anthropic研究员Levent Alpöge与纽约大学Tristan Buckmaster合作发布AI辅助修正稿。此举引发关于AI在千年数学难题中提供确切论证能力的激烈讨论，并与斯坦福人类学者独立证明草案形成直接竞逐。
topics.summary_en: Levent Alpöge (Anthropic) and Tristan Buckmaster (NYU) released an AI-aided proof to fix logical gaps in OpenAI's previous Navier-Stokes solution. This development challenges the validity of AI in solving millennium-prize problems, triggering a high-stakes race against competing drafts from Stanford human mathematicians.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 演进派：AI辅助研发加速者
perspective_pro.point_zh: AI能够处理人类数学家难以覆盖的海量推演路径，通过逻辑迭代填补证明漏洞，是人类智慧与机器算力的有效协同。
perspective_pro.point_en: AI excels at traversing vast logical branches that elude human mathematicians, effectively bridging gaps in complex proofs through iterative machine computation and collaborative human oversight.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派：数学纯粹性维护者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 斯坦福大学独立学术审查组
perspective_con.point_zh: 单纯依赖模型输出的逻辑证明缺乏对数学本质的严谨度，AI生成的解法可能隐藏逻辑死区，不应被视为确凿证据。
perspective_con.point_en: Reliance on model-generated logic proofs lacks the fundamental rigor required for pure mathematics. AI-generated solutions may harbor hidden logical dead zones, undermining their status as verifiable academic evidence.

topics.title_en: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles 10% on AI Capital Expenditure Fears
topics.summary_zh: 纳斯达克100指数经历新冠以来最惨烈单周，累计跌幅达10.4%。资本市场对AI模型高昂训练投入与微薄营收缺口的容忍度降至冰点，中国AI产业回笼压力与全球科技股下行共振，市场正从“AI信仰”转向“落地盈利性”冷思考。
topics.summary_en: The Nasdaq 100 recorded its worst weekly performance since the Covid-19 crisis, plunging 10.4%. Market sentiment has shifted from AI exuberance to cold scrutiny of the yawning gap between massive capex and actual revenue, amplified by funding pressures on Chinese AI firms.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 愿景派：长期基础设施投入者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 当前是AI范式重构的关键投入期，高额研发成本是实现算力护城河与模型技术壁垒的必要代价，而非泡沫。
perspective_pro.point_en: We are in the critical phase of paradigm shift. High R&D expenditure is the necessary price to build competitive moats in compute and model intelligence, not a sign of a bubble.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派：财务保守主义者
perspective_con.point_zh: 缺乏商业落地闭环的盲目扩张不可持续，高额资本开支未能兑现为利润率，当前估值已透支未来数年的盈利空间。
perspective_con.point_en: Blind expansion without a viable revenue model is unsustainable. Massive capex has failed to translate into profitability, and current valuations have over-leveraged future earnings by years.

topics.title_zh: 字节跳动挑战冗长训练管线，发布高效开源模型
topics.title_en: Bytedance Challenges Lengthy Training Pipelines with New Open Model
topics.summary_zh: 字节跳动联合学界发布论文与开源模型，证明AI智能体完成复杂任务无需冗长的预训练管线。与此同时，Thinking Machines推出的Inkling 2 Mini支持本地笔记本循环推理，英伟达亦质疑超长上下文的冗余性，行业正式进入‘训练减法’与‘效率至上’阶段。
topics.summary_en: Bytedance and academic partners proved that AI agents can execute complex tasks without lengthy training pipelines. Combined with the launch of the locally-run, loop-thinking model 'Inkling 2 Mini' and Nvidia's critique of context window redundancy, the industry is pivoting toward lean training and compute efficiency.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 技术实用派：算力效率优化者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 通过优化训练范式而非单纯堆叠Token，可以显著降低算力损耗，让AI在轻量化端侧设备上实现更强逻辑推理。
perspective_pro.point_en: By optimizing training paradigms instead of blindly stacking tokens, we can significantly reduce compute waste and enable superior logical reasoning on lightweight, edge-device deployments.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 算力基建派：规模扩展支持者
perspective_con.point_zh: 单纯追求‘循环思考’可能导致逻辑偏差，长上下文虽然存在冗余，但提供了处理复杂海量信息的底座，不可轻易舍弃。
perspective_con.point_en: Pursuing loop-based thinking risks logical drift. While context windows may contain redundancy, they provide the essential foundational depth required to handle massive, complex information sets.
